workflow.text:
# A made-up workflow for the viewer's fixtures; it ran nowhere.
dataforge: 1
name: sample
start: author
inputs:
  task: string
max_cost_usd: 20

states:
  author:
    uses: agent
    with:
      prompt: prompts/author.md
      notes: prompts/notes.toml
    max_visits: 3
    feedback: |
      The check found a problem, round ${round}:
      ${evidence}
    transitions:
      done: { goto: check, report: true }
  check:
    uses: script
    with: { run: [make, check] }
    max_visits: 3
    feedback: "The check failed: ${evidence}"
    transitions:
      pass: { goto: review }
      fail: { goto: author, report: true }
  review:
    uses: rubric
    with:
      reviews:
        - { name: tests, rubric: rubrics/tests.toml, inputs: [tests, solution] }
        - { name: brief, rubric: rubrics/brief.toml, inputs: [instruction] }
    max_visits: 2
    transitions:
      pass: { goto: solve }
      fail: { goto: author, report: true }
  solve:
    uses: pass_at_k
    with: { k: 4, prompt: prompts/solve.md.j2 }
    transitions:
      in_range: { end: passed }
      all_solved: { end: too_easy }
      none_solved: { end: too_hard }

entries.title: author.md

variables.name: notes
variables.source: notes.toml, one per topic of the task
variables.value: Name each test after what it checks.

variables.name: feedback
variables.source: every report handed back so far

entries.title: notes.toml
entries.text:
[[note]]
topic = "naming"
text = "Name each test after what it checks."

[[note]]
topic = "layout"
text = "Keep one test file per module of the change."

entries.title: Feedback on return
entries.text:
The check failed on this attempt, round ${round}.

${evidence}
